drivers.theme: Tech-led preopen rally and lower long yields
Hawkish Fed and global tightening cycle
Oil retreat and easing pipeline-supply fear
AI capex optimism vs regulatory/safety risk
Soft bank/FICC commentary and pullback seasonality

parsed.rationale: Preopen is risk-on with Nasdaq futures up about 1%, tech leadership, lower long yields and oil after a hawkish Fed hike was treated as credibility relief. But global tightening, soft bank commentary, AI regulatory risk and seasonal pullback talk cap conviction beyond one day.
